results.title: Chelsea Keeper Martinez 'Back In A Few Weeks' After Jaw Fracture
results.description: Chelsea goalkeeper Emiliano Martinez said he would be fit to return "in a few weeks" following surgery on a fractured jaw sustained during his team's 2-0 Premier League win at Everton.

results.title: Hyderabad bowled out for 275 after 109-run opening stand against Andhra
results.description: Hyderabad were bowled out for 275 against Andhra on the opening day of their Ranji Trophy Elite Group B match at Mulapadu. After a 109-run opening stand, Andhra’s spinners struck regularly, restricting Hyderabad before the hosts reached nine without loss

results.title: Delhi SIR: 78.5% of 33 lakh voter roll discrepancy cases resolved, says CEO
results.description: The Delhi Election Commission said it has ordered a special re-verification drive to re-enroll eligible voters who were left out of the draft electoral roll.
